numeric_metrics.cost_variance_to_date_usd: actual_cost_usd - baseline_budget_usd; negative is remaining budget, not proof of savings
numeric_metrics.forecast_budget_variance_usd: forecast_total_cost_usd - baseline_budget_usd; positive is forecast overrun
numeric_metrics.schedule_effort_gap_hours: planned_completed_effort_hours - completed_effort_hours; positive is behind planned effort

process: Final-state input hashes only; no claim of unmodified execution history.

semantic.criteria: Explain schedule/milestone and budget status with source references, forecast assumptions, resource/budget allocation and justified cost-control recommendations. Distinguish observed facts, estimates and judgment; follow the fictional approval policy.

unit_policy: USD and hours as stated in column names
